about: Owner decisions for the Booking.com to Trip.com migration. build-registry.js merges these over the verified matches. decision: map (own Trip.com link) | fallback (use fallback_key's link, optional relabel) | remove (drop the booking button, keep the content) | hold | investigate (both block cutover). overrides route specific occurrences (page + CJ sid, checked against expect) to another decision or target entry. deferred: true marks buttons removed only until a Trip.com listing is confirmed; to re-add, set decision to map with tripcom_id and remove deferred.
